grader.scenario: Wi-Fi coverage in detached garden office with third-party outdoor Cat6 cable run
grader.notes: Detached garden office Wi-Fi extension call handled by Fiona. Customer ran an outdoor Cat6 cable to a timber studio but experienced wireless drops with a consumer repeater. Agent diagnosed double-NAT and arranged a complimentary wired backhaul booster pod with empathy, but omitted security verification entirely, never used the customer's name, asked a repeat question on cable length, and omitted paraphrasing.
